newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end higher, optimism returns.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end higher, optimism returns.

text.p: 1612 GMT - Portuguese shares ended higher after a few dull sessions in which investors had taken profits in order to raise cash for the forthcoming privatisation of utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal. Some investors returned to the market with buy orders after noting that they may not obtain all the EDP shares that they want in the privatisation because of the very strong level of applications in the pre-registration period. Today's demand had also built up from an accumulation of orders from yesterday's market holidays in Britain and the U.S., dealers said. Turnover in the Lisbon cash market was 10.1 billion escudos. Dealers expected the positive trend to continue tomorrow. "I think the optimistic mood will remain tomorrow. Based on forecasts for strong demand for EDP shares, investors who recently unwound positions in Portuguese stocks will return to the market with buy orders for blue chips," a dealer said.
